task: streaming onset detector: after each 4-bit window energy, is the sound getting louder?

ports.s_data: bits [3:0] = window energy (0..15); bits [7:4] must be 0, else the error flag is set
ports.s_last: marks the last sample of a stream; it clears the history (warm-up starts again)
ports.s_ready: !m_valid | m_ready (one output register; no combinational path from s_valid)

network.window_order: w[0] applies to the OLDEST of the last four energies, w[3] to the newest

data.label_rule: label = 1 if (e2 + e3) - (e0 + e1) >= margin else 0, e0 oldest .. e3 newest: the newest two energies exceed the older two by at least margin/2 each on average
